title: GTX - 33 TRANSPONDER - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific steps to disconnect and then properly reinstall the transponder in the aircraft, including necessary access and securing procedures?
answer: Remove the Transponder . (1) Set the MASTER switch and AVIONICS switch to the off position. (2)  Remove the tailcone access/inspection plate  to get access to the NAV/COM units. Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (3)  Turn the quarterturn fastener 90 degrees counterclockwise and lift the locking lever to disengage the transponder. (4)  Move the transponder aft out of the mounting rack. (5)  Remove the transponder from the airplane.Install the Transponder . (1) Put the transponder in position with the locking lever stud in the mounting rack slot. (2)  Push the locking lever down and turn the quarter turn fastener 90 degrees clockwise to attach the transponder to the mounting rack. (3)  Install the tailcone access/inspection plate . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (4)  Do a check of the transponder to make sure it operates correctly. Refer to the Garmin G1000 Line Maintenance Manual.

Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (3)  Turn the quarterturn fastener 90 degrees counterclockwise and lift the locking lever to disengage the transponder. (4)  Move the transponder aft out of the mounting rack. (5)  Remove the transponder from the airplane.Install the Transponder . (1) Put the transponder in position with the locking lever stud in the mounting rack slot. (2)  Push the locking lever down and turn the quarter turn fastener 90 degrees clockwise to attach the transponder to the mounting rack. (3)  Install the tailcone access/inspection plate . Refer to Chapter 6, Access/Inspection Plates - Description and Operation. (4)  Do a check of the transponder to make sure it operates correctly. Refer to the Garmin G1000 Line Maintenance Manual.
